tools.name: write_todos
tools.description: Replace the plan with a complete, ordered list of tasks. Send every task each time, with its status. An empty list clears the plan. Keep the statuses current: mark a task in_progress when you start it and completed when it is done.
tools.parameters_json: {"type":"object","properties":{"todos":{"type":"array","description":"Every task of the plan, in order.","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"content":{"type":"string","description":"What the task does, in one short sentence."},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["pending","in_progress","completed"],"description":"Where the task stands."}},"required":["content","status"],"additionalProperties":false}}},"required":["todos"],"additionalProperties":false}
